messages:
maria (Partnerships): Quick sync — I'm running a 60-min 'marketplace entry workshop' with AWS/GCP/Azure listings team next Tue 9am PT to align on listing artifacts, legal checkpoints, and product packaging. Can folks confirm availability?
ajay (PM): I can make it. Can we share a minimal artifact TOC beforehand so we don't spend time listing things in the meeting?
tess (Legal): Legal here — we need: EULA, Data Processing Addendum, export controls checklist, and proof of ISO/SOC certs if available. Localization for EULA takes ~2w. Also need sample marketing copy for legal review.
sam (Product): Product — propose three package variants: Hosted API (pay-as-you-go), Dedicated (monthly commit), Private (license). SKU mapping idea: `hosted.standard`, `dedicated.enterprise`, `private.license`. Trial offering: `trial-1000-credits` with 14d expiry.
chris (Eng): From eng/ops: Confirming artifact list — AMI (AWS), GCE image (GCP), Managed Image + ARM template (Azure), launch scripts, runbook, and health check endpoints. For Azure we also need the Marketplace Offer manifest + VM image details.
ajay (PM): Also need publisher roles and storefront access: who will be publisher account owner? We should map Redwood internal roles to publisher roles (ops/product/legal).
tess (Legal): Heads-up: AWS Marketplace requires a signed listing agreement — legal will need 5 business days to review. Can we aim to have all artifacts uploaded 7 days before submission?
maria (Partnerships): Good call. Workshop agenda draft: 1) artifact checklist and owners 2) SKU & pricing mapping 3) publisher account/roles 4) legal gating + timeline 5) publishing runbook + post-go live ops. Thoughts?
sam (Product): LGTM. For pricing tiers, I'll bring example bundles and a spreadsheet for revenue-share calc.
chris (Eng): I'll prep image names and a short `deploy` script snippet. Quick snippet for AMI tag standard:
```
AMI_TAG="redwood-marketplace-2026-<region>-v1"
packer build -var "ami_tag=$AMI_TAG" packer/aws.json
```
maria (Partnerships): @deploy-bot can you create the calendar event and attach a workspace doc? :slightly_smiling_face:
deploy-bot: Meeting created: Tue Mar 31 09:00 PT — https://calendar.example.com/meet/1876543210. Doc draft created at https://docs.example.com/redwood/marketplace-entryworkshop.
ajay (PM): Action items before meeting: - owners assigned for each artifact (we'll fill in doc) - SKU + pricing draft by product - legal checklist draft by Tess - AMI/GCE/ARM examples by Chris
maria (Partnerships): Perfect. Can everyone drop a one-line owner assignment in the doc by EOD Fri? If anyone can't make the slot, shout now and we'll re-run. :thumbsup:
chris (Eng): putting myself down for images + runbook.
tess (Legal): legal and listing agreement review — will add timelines.
sam (Product): pricing + SKU mapping added.
ajay (PM): I'll coordinate publisher account permissions and bring required IAM flow.
maria (Partnerships): Thanks all — I’ll finalize agenda and send 1-pager. Meeting follow-up will include a preflight checklist with target upload deadlines. Closing for now. :wave:
